liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1977-10-06.164815.sbd.miller.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1977-10-06.164355.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 20 songs; 172 min; rated 3.14/5 by 7 [2]
- **gd1977-10-06.sbd.heath.19138.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 147 min; rated 2.83/5 by 6 [3]. Said about its sound: Bright sound; Bob Weir's tone is limber, adding a unique layer; Nice guitar weaving between Bob and Jerry with good energy [13]
- **gd1977-10-06.sbd.unk.101801.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 143 min; rated 1.75/5 by 4 [4]
- **gd1977-10-06.164827.aud.gale.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 20 songs; 150 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1977-10-06.fm.kbfh.77476.sbeok.flac16**: FM broadcast; 10 songs; 79 min; rated 4.2/5 by 10 [8]. Said about its sound: Described as murderous and fast, with the band barely holding it together; Completely insane performance, even with a Minglewood Blues break later; Faster than usual and absolutely rocking, according to the listener [10][11][12][14]

## Around the show

- Lyric difference noted: 'don't worry bout me' in this version [15]
- Any 1977 show is welcome, though 2-26-77 is the favorite [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-10-06.164815.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by All Mastering by Charlie Miller  July 27, 2018 (original mastering) April 10, 2023 (dozens of clicks cleaned up) May 22, 2023 (patched tape flips); source: SBD > Cassette Master > DAT (48k) > WAV [1]. Also: King Biscuit Flour Hour FM broadcast, reel master, then FLAC transfer; Audience cassette patches supplied by Dan Gale for specific song sections [1]
- **gd1977-10-06.164355.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by All Mastering by Charlie Miller  July 27, 2018 (original mastering) April 10, 2023 (dozens of clicks cleaned up); source: SBD > Cassette Master > DAT (48k) > WAV [2]. Also: Tape flips noted in They Love Each Other and Eyes Of the World; Tape two runs out during the Uncle John's Band jam section [2]
- **gd1977-10-06.sbd.heath.19138.shnf**: transferred by Brian Heath; source: S: Reel Master > Cassette > DAT > CD [3]
- **gd1977-10-06.sbd.unk.101801.shnf**: transferred by SBD: Unknown Lineage > CDR > MKWACT > SHN [4]. Also: Obtained on CDRs via trade; no source info; converted to SHN; Most of They Love Each Other is missing and joined in progress [4]
- **gd1977-10-06.164827.aud.gale.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Audience source of unknown provenance from Dan Gale's collection [5]. Also: Looks Like Rain clipped; New Minglewood Blues missing last half [5]
- **gd1977-10-06.fm.kbfh.77476.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Dennis C; source: FM > C(x2) > Marantz CDR-510 (rec at -0db) > CDR > EAC > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH (for SBE-OK, checksums, and FLAC compression) > FLAC [8]
